text:
orla.p: Heads-up  we have vendor CobaltSky starting next Mon 09:30 PT. Final scope ask: ephemeral RBAC for assessors, KMS-presign/evidence pipeline, audit-forwarding SLA, and a retest cadence.

rahul.k: Proposed RBAC window 08:30-10:30 PT (2h). Must be explicit allowlist for who can assume the external assessor role. Also require MFA for any elevate during window.

sam.t: Agree. Use the ephemeral bake pipeline and require role chaining only (no console perms). Presigned URLs TTL 10-15m, bucket prefix enforced to pen-tests/exports/, and object tagging for request_id. Ops, can you reserve a 3-4h retest slot exactly 7 days after a fix merge?

jin.w: I validated the presign flow on staging. Flow: presign-lambda -> keystore-proxy -> KMS GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + Sign. We must NOT give Decrypt to assessor principals. I'll put a minimal policy in the runbook. Example excerpt: 
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext","kms:Sign","s3:PutObject"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222:key/CSKY-EX-01"]
}
```

orla.p: Important: we need an attestation step for key-wrapping state before/after fixes. Add keystore snapshot + verification hash in the manifest. We should also record the KMS key policy version used during test.

ops-bot: [ephemeral-bake] scheduled: ephemeral/assessor-bake-2026-06-15T15:00Z -> expires 2026-06-15T19:00Z.

rahul.k: KMS audit requirement: CloudTrail must show Sign/Generate operations and key-usage metrics forwarded to audit index within 5m. If a finding involves keys, auto-label `requires-kms-review` and page KMS SME for severity >= high.

sam.t: For evidence hygiene: presign TTL 10m, enforce x-amz-meta-request-id on objects, and ensure presigned PUT only allowed from presign lambda role. Jin, can we add an allow-list check in the lambda?

jin.w: Done on staging. Lambda enforces bucket prefix and signer role allow-list. I'll add the keystorectl snapshot command and a verify step to the runbook: `keystorectl snapshot --id $RUN_ID && keystorectl verify --snapshot snapshot-$RUN_ID.tar.gz` and include a hashed manifest.

orla.p: Intake workflow: vendor report -> intake sheet + webhook -> create vuln issue on project pen-2026-q2. Issue must capture severity, repro steps, owner, artifacts, `requires-kms-review` flag, and retest ETA. Prefer a lightweight Google Sheet intake to start and webhook to GH.

rahul.k: I'll add label mappings: `requires-kms-review`, `rbac`, `data-exposure`. Also map `requires-kms-review` + high -> page KMS SME oncall.

sam.t: Retest coordination: reserve an env snapshot and a keystore snapshot at fix time. Snapshots retained 72h after retest. Ops should produce a snapshot-manifest.json containing keystore snapshot id and CloudTrail export hash for the retest window.

jin.w: Runbook CloudTrail validation example (CloudWatch Logs Insights friendly): 
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.userName
| filter eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" and (eventName = "GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext" or eventName = "Sign")
| sort @timestamp desc
```
And a quick check for unintended Decrypt calls: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-cobaltsky | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'
```

orla.p: IR rule: if vendor demonstrates a live exploit chain or data exfil, escalate immediately to soc-oncall and open an incident in #incidents. Treat that as IR (outside normal pen-test retest flow). Include SOC contact card in runbook.

rahul.k: I'll draft escalation mapping, approver list for RBAC changes, and hotfix checklist (roll-forward vs rollback acceptance criteria, evidence capture steps).

sam.t: Ops action: reserve retest window and enforce snapshot retention policy. I'll confirm calendar invites after bake completes.

jin.w: Action: publish runbook with minimal IAM/KMS policy, presign lambda checklist, snapshot manifest schema, and intake webhook details by EOD tomorrow. I'll post link here when ready.

orla.p: Thanks all. Final owners: Jin (runbook + form/webhook + presign policy), Rahul (escalation + labels + approvers list), Sam (reserve retest + snapshots). Will share finalized scope with vendor after ephemeral bake passes. :thumbsup:
